forecasts.question: Will AGI be developed before 1 January 2030?
forecasts.key_change: No material change; DeepMind's new 10-trait AGI framework highlights remaining gaps despite rapid capability gains in coding and reasoning.
forecasts.base_rate: Expert median ~20-25% for AGI by 2030 (aggregating Metaculus, prediction markets)

factors_up.factor: Claude Opus 4.5 solving 5-hour expert tasks at 50% reliability
Anthropic CEO says vast majority of new model code written by AI
DeepMind co-founder Legg: 50% chance by 2028

factors_down.factor: Stanford HAI: era shifting from evangelism to evaluation; real utility still questioned
No lab has publicly claimed AGI; 10-trait framework shows major gaps remain
Gary Marcus and others argue AGI claims greatly exaggerated

key_uncertainties: Whether current scaling paradigm hits a wall before 2030
Definition disagreements could delay formal AGI announcements even if capability threshold met

update_triggers.up: A major lab announces AGI-level performance on standard benchmarks or autonomous research capability
update_triggers.down: Scaling laws plateau; major lab pivots away from foundation model approach

forecasts.question: Will economic consultancy lose ≥33% value/jobs by end 2030 due to AI?
forecasts.key_change: McKinsey cutting ~10% of workforce; junior consultant hiring down 40% since 2020; restructuring accelerating but revenue still growing at top firms.
forecasts.base_rate: No historical precedent for 33% decline in professional services within 6 years

factors_up.factor: McKinsey 10% layoffs; junior hiring dropped from 41% to 26% of roles
AI tools increasingly doing junior analyst work (data analysis, slide creation)
Senior consultant hiring up 55% — suggests structural shift not just cuts

factors_down.factor: Revenue still growing at major firms; AI creates new advisory demand
33% is an extremely high bar; even financial crisis didn't hit consulting that hard
Forrester: half of AI layoffs quietly rehired (offshore or lower salary)

key_uncertainties: Whether AI displaces or augments senior consultants by 2030
Speed of client willingness to substitute AI for human consultants on complex strategy

update_triggers.up: Major consulting firm reports >15% revenue decline YoY attributed to AI
update_triggers.down: Consulting revenue grows >5% annually through 2027 despite AI adoption

forecasts.question: Will Labour be largest party at next UK General Election?
forecasts.key_change: Electoral Calculus April 2026 projects Labour in FIFTH place (69 seats); Reform at 266 seats. Green surge taking 68 Labour seats directly.
forecasts.base_rate: Incumbent governing parties win ~60% of UK elections historically, but Labour's position is historically unprecedented in its weakness

factors_up.factor: 3+ years until election deadline (Aug 2029); significant time for recovery
Reform has never governed; novelty could wear off

factors_down.factor: MRP projection: Labour FIFTH behind Reform, Cons, Greens, LibDems
Reform projected 266 seats vs Labour 69; 197-seat gap is enormous
Starmer's popularity at record lows; Green surge specifically targeting Labour seats
Fragmentation on left (Greens, LibDems) splitting anti-Reform vote

key_uncertainties: Whether Reform can sustain support through to actual election
Possibility of Labour leadership change and policy reset

update_triggers.up: Labour consistently polls above Reform for 3+ months; leadership change sparks recovery
update_triggers.down: Reform wins major local election cycles; Labour falls below 15% in polls

forecasts.question: Will AGI be developed before 1 January 2035?
forecasts.key_change: Incremental update; AI self-improvement accelerating (AI writing AI code) but evaluation frameworks increasingly highlighting remaining gaps.
forecasts.base_rate: Expert median ~60-70% for AGI by 2035 (Metaculus, expert surveys)

factors_up.factor: AI systems now writing majority of their own training code
Capability doubling time appears to be shrinking
Multiple credible experts (Legg, Hassabis) cluster predictions around 2028-2032

factors_down.factor: DeepMind 10-trait framework reveals substantial gaps in several dimensions
Shift to 'evaluation era' may reveal overstated capabilities

key_uncertainties: Whether recursive self-improvement creates discontinuous capability jumps
Regulatory interventions could slow deployment and research

update_triggers.up: AI system autonomously conducts novel scientific research published in top journals
update_triggers.down: Major scaling run yields minimal capability improvement; paradigm shift needed

forecasts.question: Will China initiate a military blockade or invasion of Taiwan before 1 January 2030?
forecasts.key_change: ASPI analysis argues 2026 is not the year; economic costs ($2-10T) remain strong deterrent. But Dec 2025 saw 100+ aircraft in one day — military pressure intensifying.
forecasts.base_rate: Superpower military conflicts against defended targets: ~2-5% per year base rate

factors_up.factor: Dec 2025: 100+ aircraft, 90 crossing median line — most intense single-day episode
War on the Rocks: deterrence may be 'bypassed' via gray-zone escalation
3.7 years remaining in window; cumulative risk compounds

factors_down.factor: Economic cost estimates $2-10 trillion; semiconductor dependency constrains China
Intelligence suggests China lacks concrete invasion plans by 2027
ASPI: Xi's scorecard doesn't favour 2026; preference for non-military unification

key_uncertainties: Whether gray-zone escalation (quarantine vs blockade) crosses resolution threshold
Impact of US political transition on deterrence credibility

update_triggers.up: China conducts full-scale military exercise simulating Taiwan invasion with live fire
update_triggers.down: Cross-strait diplomatic engagement resumes; military exercises decrease

forecasts.question: Will UK annual CPI inflation fall below 2.0% for at least one month before 1 January 2027?
forecasts.key_change: BoE revised inflation UP to 3.0-3.5% for Q2-Q3 2026 due to Middle East conflict energy shock; Feb 2026 CPI at 3.0%. Only 8 months remain.
forecasts.base_rate: When CPI is at 3.0% with upward energy pressure, probability of falling below 2.0% within 8 months is very low historically

factors_up.factor: Motor fuels making downward contribution to February CPI
Potential for sudden energy price collapse if Middle East conflict resolves

factors_down.factor: BoE revised forecast UP to 3.0-3.5% for Q2-Q3 2026 (was 2.1% before)
CPI at 3.0% in Feb; needs to fall 1+ percentage points in remaining months
Housing/utilities inflation at 4.6% providing persistent upward pressure

key_uncertainties: Middle East conflict trajectory and its effect on energy prices
Whether clothing/services inflation falls faster than expected

update_triggers.up: Middle East ceasefire causes >30% drop in energy prices; March CPI comes in below 2.5%
update_triggers.down: April energy cap increases as expected; Q2 CPI readings above 3%

forecasts.question: Will Spider-Man: Brand New Day gross over $1.5B worldwide by 31 December 2026?
forecasts.key_change: Trailer hit 1 BILLION views (first in history); projections now $2.3-2.5B worldwide. Release July 31 gives 5 months of theatrical run.
forecasts.base_rate: MCU films with $1B+ trailer views and massive pre-release hype: No Way Home hit $1.92B

factors_up.factor: First trailer ever to reach 1 billion views; 718M in first 24 hours
Industry projections at $2.3-2.5B worldwide — well above $1.5B threshold
No Way Home ($1.92B) sets strong floor for sequel hype

factors_down.factor: Film not yet released (July 31); production/quality risks remain
Global macroeconomic headwinds could suppress discretionary spending

key_uncertainties: Film quality and critical reception upon release

update_triggers.up: Early reviews are overwhelmingly positive; opening weekend exceeds $300M domestic
update_triggers.down: Major production issues emerge; negative early reviews; release delayed

forecasts.question: Will OpenAI and Anthropic have a combined ARR exceeding $70B by 31 December 2026?
forecasts.key_change: Combined ARR now ~$54B (Anthropic $30B + OpenAI $24B) in April 2026. Need $16B more in 8 months. Anthropic grew $21B in 4 months; trajectory strongly supportive.
forecasts.base_rate: Hyper-growth SaaS companies at this scale: >80% probability of reaching +30% growth over 8 months given current trajectories

factors_up.factor: Combined ARR already $54B; only need 30% growth in 8 months
Anthropic grew from $9B to $30B in ~4 months; enterprise demand accelerating
Anthropic enterprise clients >$1M doubled in 2 months (500→1000)

factors_down.factor: Growth rates may decelerate as base gets larger
Competitive pressure from Google, Meta open-source could compress margins
Enterprise budgets may face tightening in H2 2026

key_uncertainties: Whether Anthropic's growth rate sustains or decelerates from current pace
OpenAI consumer revenue trajectory with increasing competition

update_triggers.down: Either company reports revenue growth stalling; major enterprise contract cancellations

forecasts.question: Will UK average annual real GDP growth exceed 1.5% across the 2030s (2030-2039)?
forecasts.key_change: OBR March 2026 forecasts 1.6% average growth but only through forecast horizon; EY settles at 1.4% from 2028; underlying productivity weakness persists.
forecasts.base_rate: UK average real GDP growth 2010-2019: ~1.7%; 2000-2009: ~1.8%; post-2016 trend: ~1.3%

factors_up.factor: OBR forecasts 1.6% average over medium term
AI productivity gains could boost growth by 0.3-0.5pp if adopted widely

factors_down.factor: EY/Goldman expect only 1.3-1.4% settling growth rate
CBI: underlying weaknesses holding economy back; weak private demand
Public debt at 95% GDP in early 2030s constrains fiscal stimulus

key_uncertainties: Scale and timing of AI-driven productivity gains in UK economy
Whether post-Brexit trade friction effects diminish or persist through 2030s

update_triggers.up: UK productivity growth exceeds 1.5% for consecutive quarters; major trade deals signed
update_triggers.down: UK enters recession; productivity growth remains below 1% through 2027
